notes.title: 🔔Update 1.04.05🔔
notes.content:
[b][h2]Developer comments[/h2][/b]
 First, we really appreciate the interest from so many gamers. We're especially grateful to the YouTubers, Steam curators, and streamers who reached out to us first. You've made the game shine.
As for the difficulty, we're currently looking at a number of different directions, which will take a little more time. We hope you'll stay tuned and we'll be back with an even better experience.

[b][h2]1. System Errors[/h2][/b]

notes.title: 🔔Update 1.04.03🔔
notes.content:
[h2][b]1. Combine Cards[/b][/h2]
- Jackpot : Downgraded from rare to uncommon grade, damage changed from 150 to 100
- Return : Damage changed from 5 to 10
- Ringing : Damage changed from 2 to 3
- Shadow : Downgraded from rare to uncommon grade
- Sacrifice : HP consumption changed from 3 to 2
- Spinning a Bomb : Upgraded from uncommon to rare grade
- Top Dealing : Downgraded from uncommon to common grade
- Funny : Damage changed from 3 to 5

[h2][b]2. Adding graphics[/b][/h2]
- Adding an image when clearing an ENDLESS mode stage

[h2][b]Developer comments[/b][/h2]
 We looked at the current state of play and realized that decks that deal a lot of damage at once were being used a lot. While peak performance is higher for decks that attack with multiple low-damage attacks, we realized that meeting multiple conditions was causing a decline in usage of these decks, so we balanced them to make them easier to obtain and increase their minimum performance. 
 We've also adjusted cards that have difficult conditions that make them harder to use.

tags.balance_change: - Jackpot : Downgraded from rare to uncommon grade, damage changed from 150 to 100
- Shadow : Downgraded from rare to uncommon grade
- Sacrifice : HP consumption changed from 3 to 2
- Spinning a Bomb : Upgraded from uncommon to rare grade
- Top Dealing : Downgraded from uncommon to common grade
